body:
Receipt of a notice under Section 148 marks the commencement of reassessment proceedings. Under the amended statutory framework governed by Section 148A, assessing officers must provide prior opportunity of being heard by issuing a show-cause notice under Section 148A(b).

Key Defense Measures:
1. Audit the Sanction Order: Verify whether approval from the Specified Authority under Section 151 was legally obtained.
2. Reconcile AIS/TIS Records: Cross-examine high-value financial transactions against submitted schedules.
3. Challenge Non-Providing of Information: File objections if department evidence is withheld.

Assessees must submit itemized, evidence-backed replies within the 30-day statutory limitation window.
title: Legal Defense Strategy for Section 148 Income Tax Reassessment Notices
summary: A comprehensive roadmap for replying to reassessment notices under Section 148 and Section 148A of the Income Tax Act.
